headline: Xbox Cuts More Jobs as Activision Takes Over Halo Franchise
summary: Microsoft laid off Xbox staff and handed the Halo, Sea of Thieves and Age of Empires franchises to Activision as part of its ongoing gaming 'reset', according to The Verge, BBC and Engadget. Outlets give different figures for the day's job cuts and for the total planned losses under the reset.
